technical-summary: Corrected the RUM09 release gates to match the selected TP1 Flash-Next first lane and make the candidate runtime roster enforceable. Mixed-TP hardware qualification is required only for profiles actually included in the package. Updated stale source-review artifacts to mark ABI41 target inventories as historical.
user-summary-candidate: The release plan now starts with the selected TP1 deployment and explicitly requires packaging to exclude any unqualified profiles. Mixed-TP proof is only required if those profiles are shipped.
